# The Industrial Scribe

> Frameworks and AI prompts for office staff in Southeast Asian manufacturing: planners, QC executives, purchasing and business-development coordinators. Written by Ah Hock, a pen name, from inside a real Malaysian manufacturing office. For office staff, never for programmers.

Ah Hock publishes only what he has run on real work, uses real numbers, and never names a customer. There is no single standard method in manufacturing: each piece starts by diagnosing the nature of the business, then customises the workflow.

## Start here
- [Home: the shelf](https://theindustrialscribe.com/): What TIS is and the shelf of single items, pay once: The Waste Hunt (USD 3.99), the "Okay, Noted." Fix (USD 9.99), Workflow Swimlanes (USD 0.99), the Email Intelligence Desk (USD 9.99), and two real case-study PDFs (USD 9.99 each). Plus the two real case studies in full, how it works, and the FAQ.
- [The Waste Hunt](https://theindustrialscribe.com/waste-hunt.html): A 30-minute AI interview about one task you redo every week: seven questions on your factory, then the task step by step, the waste map with hours per month, what to cut first, what to automate and how far, and a build guide for number one. Paste box for any AI chat (free plans included) or a Claude Code skill (needs Claude Pro). USD 3.99 once. Office workflows only; hours saved are an estimate until timed.
- ["Okay, Noted." Fix](https://theindustrialscribe.com/okay-noted.html): Slides and dashboards people act on. Decks of 3 to 5 slides with takeaway titles and the ask with a date; a so-what dashboard with an ACT TODAY band and a tile per measure that says what to do and who does it; a check for slides already made. Paste box for any AI chat or a Claude Code skill that does the maths with a script. USD 9.99 once. It will not invent targets, owners or causes.
- [Email Intelligence Desk](https://theindustrialscribe.com/email-reply.html): Paste the whole customer email chain and get the catch-up (who, what was promised, what is overdue, what they ask now), a warning if the request goes against your own rules or a past decision, one recommended position, and a reply in your language and tone with every date and number checked against the thread; it learns your style from a few sent emails, keeps a card per customer, keeps your edits, never sends. Paste box for any AI chat or a Claude Code skill. USD 9.99 once. Pairs with the email case study.
- [Workflow Swimlanes](https://theindustrialscribe.com/swimlanes.html): A Claude Code skill that draws how your automation should run (lanes: you, the model, scripts) and rebuilds what actually ran from the session logs on your own computer. Needs Claude Pro and Python 3. USD 0.99 once.
- Real case studies (PDF, USD 9.99 each, on the shelf): "How I Stopped Losing Promises in Email Threads: The Reply Is Drafted Before I Open the Email" (28 pages, the AI files every email into a case, remembers what was promised and drafts the reply, real numbers from one user over seven weeks) and "Building So-What Reports: Every Number Says What to Do Next" (23 pages, decks and dashboards built on 856,850 real operations; time saved and decisions changed were never tracked). Both in the format of Anthropic's "Building Effective AI Agents" guide, anonymised.
- The Build Your AI Back-Office kit is no longer sold (withdrawn November 2026). Past buyers keep their download page and free updates.
- [About Ah Hock](https://theindustrialscribe.com/about.html): Who writes this and the rules he writes by
- [The Insider Test (free)](https://theindustrialscribe.com/insider-test.html): 30-question test on how you work in a factory office and how you use AI; gives your type and an AI direction for your job
- [The Pre-Ship Checklist (free)](https://theindustrialscribe.com/free-checklist.html): Free 10-point checklist to run before any deck goes to a boss or a customer

## Free tools
- [Weekly WIP Status Report](https://theindustrialscribe.com/skill-wip-status-report.html): A copy-paste AI skill that teaches ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to produce a Monday-ready Weekly WIP Status Report from raw job data.
